purpose: Reusable Pritha reference pack for browser Realtime voice control, server-side tool routing and Codex deep-task transport.
use_when: A descendant contract explicitly selects realtime voice control.
The agent needs live voice UX plus durable server-side tools.
Complex voice-triggered work must be routed to Codex App, Codex CLI or a queue instead of being performed by the voice model directly.
do_not_use_when: The agent only needs transcription or simple chat.
There is no trusted server boundary for OpenAI API keys and durable tools.
The user has not approved microphone, cost, privacy and deployment constraints.
required_adaptation: Replace FESPA-specific repos, tool names, env prefixes and feed/media domain logic.
Define descendant-specific tool schemas and publication/destructive-action confirmation gates.
Keep OPENAI_API_KEY server-side and issue only ephemeral Realtime credentials to the browser.
Select Codex transport per contract: codex-app-server, codex-auto, codex-session or codex-app-http.
Add readiness checks for internet, memory and Codex CLI/App transport when selected.
